you.name: Your name
you.nameHint: Used to greet you on Home.
you.exportHint: A spreadsheet file with everything in Vibravault
you.rulesIntro: A rule gives bank text a readable name and a category, for every transaction that contains it. You make one from a transaction: tap it, then ⋯ → Rename & sort all like this.
you.rulesEmpty: No rules yet. They'll show up here once you make one.
you.ruleDeleteConfirm: Delete the rule for “{match}”? Its name disappears from every transaction. Categories it already set stay.
you.phoneIntro: Import a bank file straight from your banking app's Share button, without saving it first. Setting it up takes about 5 minutes, once.
you.step1: Create a key for this iPhone
you.step1Body: The key lets the Shortcut add transactions to your vault, and nothing else.
you.keyCopyNow: Copy it now. For your safety it's never shown again.
you.step2Body: In the Shortcuts app on your iPhone:
you.s1: Tap + at the top right. Tap the search bar at the bottom, type URL and add the action Get Contents of URL.
you.s3: Tap Show More and set Method to POST.
you.s4: Under Headers, add a header named:
you.s4b: …with your key from step 1 as its value.
you.s5: Set Request Body to File, and pick Shortcut Input.
you.s6: Search for Show Notification the same way and add it. Tap the text inside it and pick Contents of URL from the bar above the keyboard. That notification tells you what was imported.
you.s7: Open the Shortcut details (ⓘ), turn on Show in Share Sheet and allow Files.
you.step3Body: In your banking app, export your transactions as CSV, tap Share and choose Vibravault. A notification tells you what was added. Transactions you already have are skipped.
you.revokeConfirm: Remove the key for “{name}”? Its Shortcut stops working right away.
you.pwDone: Password changed. You're signed out everywhere else.
